name: radio
title: Radio
description: A small round well for one choice among several.
use: One choice among a few options that all stay visible, a row each. Radios that share a name form one group; put the group in a fieldset with a legend.

instead.when: Any number of the options can be chosen
There are two to five short options that fit in one row
There are more options than fit, or space is tight
Each option needs a title and a sentence
The choice filters a view at once

keyboard.action: Reaches the chosen radio of a group, or the first when none is chosen
Move the choice along the radios that share a name

classes.name: radio
classes.description: A native type="radio" input: a round well

states.name: checked
states.description: The well fills with ink and shows a dot

example:
<fieldset class="fieldset">
  <legend class="fieldset-legend">Visibility</legend>
  <label class="check"><input type="radio" class="radio" name="visibility" value="public" checked> Public</label>
  <label class="check"><input type="radio" class="radio" name="visibility" value="team"> Team only</label>
  <label class="check"><input type="radio" class="radio" name="visibility" value="private"> Private</label>
</fieldset>
